## §3 Stage gates (real git checks — NOT in-memory FIFO)

### Stage 1 → Stage 2 (kickoffs authored → S-B ∥ S-C dispatch)

```bash
git fetch origin staging -q && git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/staging .claude/orchestrator-prompts/ \
  | grep -E 'arch-v2-context-pipeline-s-(b|c)/kickoff\.md'
```

Expected: **two** lines (the s-b and s-c kickoff paths). Fewer → halt; the missing stage is not dispatchable (`#dispatch-before-staging`).

### Stage 2 → Stage 3 (S-C merged → S-D dispatch)

```bash
gh pr list --search "arch-v2 s-c in:title is:merged base:staging" --json number,title,mergedAt --limit 10
```

Expected: non-empty. Empty → halt; do NOT dispatch S-D. S-D's **tier is unassigned** until the S-C verdict PR assigns it with justification (umbrella §4 O-5).

### S-E admission gate (cross-umbrella, two gates not one — umbrella §3)

```bash
gh pr list --search "session-start-token-audit in:title is:merged base:staging" --json number,title --limit 10
```

Merged is gate 1. **Gate 2 is content-read:** S1's own falsifier («if our injected set is <40 % of the measured session-start total…»). If it fired, S-E's ceilings cover a minority share and the gate scope must be re-derived before S-E ships. Reading «S1 merged» as sufficient is `#hope-as-gate`.

### S-F admission gate

token-audit **S2** timing; plus the two §0 marker conditions re-verified **at dispatch time** (uniqueness of `Z.AI GLM-5.2 SDK` in `GET /runtime-profiles`; `fidelity-verdict-in-pr-body` still in `required_status_checks`).

**Phase -1 cold-review between every stage transition is MANDATORY** (see §7 below), and the four-arm in-flight probe is **re-run after Phase -1 completes** — all three historical collisions materialised inside that window (umbrella §0).

## §4 Sub-wave dispatch instructions

### Stage 1 — K-BC: author the S-B and S-C stage kickoffs

Not an aif dispatch. A top-tier planning seat authors both stage kickoffs from the umbrella §1 stage briefs + the design SSOT, in **one PR** (precedent: #1189 shipped the umbrella + S-A kickoffs together; kickoffs are dispatch inputs, not stage deliverables, so this does not collapse stages). Each stage kickoff MUST carry:

- a `host-verify` fenced block (or an explicit ≥20-char opt-out) — [destination-environment-verification.md §1](../../rules/destination-environment-verification.md);
- an `## §N AI-laziness traps` section with an explicit T-enumeration + ≥1 domain trap — [ai-laziness-traps.md §3](../../rules/ai-laziness-traps.md), gated by principle 12;
- **NO** `bridge-profile` marker (umbrella §1 + §4 O-6 — S-B and S-C dispatch without it);
- S-B additionally: the watch-list design input (umbrella §1 S-B «Design input» paragraph) as an explicit acceptance item, with [`cold-seat-economy.md §3`](../../rules/cold-seat-economy.md) named as the doc to update once the durable home is chosen.

Merge to `staging` → **only then** dispatch Stage 2.

### Stage 2 — S-B ∥ S-C (parallel, isolated worktrees)

Disjoint surfaces (S-B writes contract + ledger artefacts; S-C writes a research verdict), so parallel is admissible. Each takes its own worktree per [parallel-subwave-isolation.md §1](../../rules/parallel-subwave-isolation.md):

```bash
bash scripts/create-worktree.sh arch-v2-s-b
bash scripts/create-worktree.sh arch-v2-s-c
```

Both Tier 2 → dispatch **without** the marker (top tier plans in aif). Autonomous dispatch is available (bridge configured, profiles listed above): each stage kickoff must carry the §4c park-don't-guess contract before `dispatch.ts` is used; otherwise use maintainer-paste tabs.

### Stage 3 — S-D (contingent)

Dispatch only after S-C merges, at the tier its verdict PR assigns. On a null verdict the deliverable is an L2-closure PR (retirement note + `done.md`), not a build.

### S-E, S-F — gated, out of the current window

Do not author or dispatch until their admission gates above are green.

## §4b §1.7 PR-body authoring mandate (paths-triggered — applies to every stage of this umbrella)

Every stage of this umbrella touches `.claude/rules/**`, `.claude/skills/**`, `agents/**` or `docs/meta-factory/**`, so the mandate applies to all of them. Required PR-body sections, verbatim shape:

```markdown
### §1.7 Forward-check applied

<≥40 non-whitespace chars enumerating which existing disciplines were checked>

- `doc-authority-hierarchy.md` — <what was checked>. file:line evidence: `<path>:<line>`
- `build-first-reuse-default.md` — <verdict + rationale>
- `no-paid-llm-in-ci.md` — <verdict>

### §1.7 Backward-check applied

<≥40 non-whitespace chars enumerating the sweep of sibling surfaces the diff did NOT touch>

- `<sibling-surface>` — SWEPT-CLEAN(evidence `<path>:<line>`) | GAP-FOUND(action)
```

Hard rules, each of which has historically failed the gate: heading depth **H3**; the word **«applied»**; **≥40** non-whitespace chars per section; **≥1** `file.ext:NN` citation per section. Pre-flight before `gh pr create`:

```bash
echo "$PR_BODY" | grep -cE '^### §1\.7 (Forward|Backward)-check applied'   # must be 2
echo "$PR_BODY" | grep -cE '[^[:space:]]+\.[a-z]+:[0-9]+'                  # must be ≥2
```

Per umbrella §5 T21: a backward-check whose surface list equals the diff's own file list is non-conformant by format — delegate the sweep to [`agents/backward-sweep-auditor.md`](../../../agents/backward-sweep-auditor.md), handing it the change *class* only.

## §4c Autonomous aif-handoff dispatch — park-don't-guess contract

Live for any stage dispatched via `tsx packages/runtime-bridge/src/cli/dispatch.ts <kickoff>`; inert for maintainer-paste tabs.

**Lever 1 — conservative aif config, set before dispatch:**

```bash
export AGENT_MAX_REVIEW_ITERATIONS=1
export AGENT_AUTO_REVIEW_STRATEGY=closure_first
export AGENT_SKIP_REVIEW=false
```

**Lever 2 — park-don't-guess (carried verbatim in each dispatched stage kickoff):**

> **aif agent — fork discipline (non-negotiable):** On ANY genuine fork or ambiguity (two defensible implementations, an undecided design choice, a missing spec detail that changes behaviour) — **do NOT pick.** Park it as a question (set the task to `manualReviewRequired` / `blocked_external` with the fork stated as «Option A → consequence X / Option B → consequence Y») and **stop that task.** Proceed only on the unambiguous parts.

**Pre-dispatch gate:** `grep -qi 'park it as a question' <stage-kickoff>` AND `[ -n "$AGENT_MAX_REVIEW_ITERATIONS" ]`. Either missing → STOP.

**Egress gate (mandatory once `status=done`):** aif does not push or open PRs by design.

```bash
npx tsx packages/runtime-bridge/src/cli/harvest.ts <taskId> --base staging
```

Skipping it is `#autonomous-done-no-harvest` — the work stays in the container forever.

## §4d Cold-seat economy (applies to every acceptance round of this umbrella)

Per [`cold-seat-economy.md`](../../rules/cold-seat-economy.md), merged during this very umbrella:

- **§1** — a fidelity verdict is re-earned by a change in *what the seat judges*, never by the head SHA moving. Same deliverables + same permitted files + same descopes → refresh the standing `GO` with a **narrow cold delta check** (incremental diff + scope sections + watch-list, **inlined** in the dispatch prompt), not a full re-audit. A commit answering a `REVISE` still earns a real `Round: n+1`.
- **§2** — dispatch cold seats **serially, cheapest-consequence first**; the expensive WHAT-conformance audit runs **last, on the final diff**.
- **§3** — follow-up rounds default to a **fresh narrow seat + watch-list**, inputs inlined («answer without reading files»); resuming is the exception, not a cost lever (~11 %).

## §5 AI-traps active (per `ai-laziness-traps.md §3`)

See [.claude/rules/ai-laziness-traps.md §2](../../rules/ai-laziness-traps.md) for the full catalogue.

**Active canonical traps for arch-v2-context-pipeline (meta-launch): T2, T3, T4, T7, T11, T14, T15, T16, T19, T20, T21.**

- **T2** — designing ≠ running. S-B's contract is not «shipped» until it has been run against a real dispatch input and that run is a ledger row.
- **T3** — every claim about upstream, the runtime or a sibling surface carries a command + output or a quoted `file:line`. No prose-only findings.
- **T4** — no stage is closed because «the remaining part is small»; the §3 gate command decides.
- **T7** — the adversarial counter-prompt is written and **run** (§7 Phase -1), never asserted.
- **T11** — S-C's verdict runs the BFR mechanism (SSOT consult + DeepWiki + WebSearch ≥3 phrasings) before proposing any channel.
- **T14** — a clean bottom-seat or shadow run at low coverage is logged as «coverage insufficient», never «input clean».
- **T15** — each stage states what running the pipeline *on this stage* produced (which kill channel fired, which drill-down was recorded) — not that the pipeline exists.
- **T16** — «Upstream problem class: X. Our problem class: Y. Match? evidence:» for every ADOPT/ADAPT S-C proposes.
- **T19** — own adversarial cold-QA of each stage diff before handoff; CI green ≠ design review.
- **T20** — no verdict in any stage PR body without an evidence-bearing tool call in the same turn.
- **T21** — every §1.7 backward-check enumerates sibling surfaces the diff did NOT touch, verdicting each `SWEPT-CLEAN(evidence)` / `GAP-FOUND(action)`.

**Domain-specific traps (meta-launch-specific, NOT in the canonical catalogue):**

- **T-META-A — «S-A merged, therefore S-B and S-C are dispatchable».** The umbrella's stage table lists S-B and S-C as depending only on S-A, which invites dispatching them the moment #1192 lands. Their *kickoffs do not exist*, so a dispatch would either no-op or resolve to a stale same-named artefact (`#dispatch-before-staging`, the exact 2026-06-16 incident). Counter: §3 Stage-1→2 gate is a `git ls-tree` on `origin/staging` returning **two** lines, not a judgment.
- **T-META-B — «the bottom seat covers this dispatch».** ADR-6's dispatch-input contract is *built by S-B*, so it cannot check S-B's own input, nor S-C's. Claiming pipeline coverage for stages authored before the station exists is `#hope-as-gate`. Counter: compensating coverage for Stage 2 is exactly and only — the umbrella §4 objections, the §7 Phase -1 review, and each stage's own acceptance commands. Coverage is claimed per-run from a ledger row, never per-umbrella.
- **T-META-C — «refresh the fidelity verdict by re-running the full audit».** The umbrella that merged `cold-seat-economy.md` is the worst place to burn a full re-audit on a SHA move. Counter: §4d — scope check + narrow inlined cold delta; a full re-audit must be justified by moved deliverables / permitted files / descopes.

## §7 Phase -1 reviewer dispatch (between stages)

Before dispatching Stage N+1, spawn a read-only adversarial Agent over the stage kickoff + the design spec — **artifact paths only, never this session's context**:

```text
Agent: Phase -1 cold-review for arch-v2-context-pipeline Stage <N>
Role: reviewer (not orchestrator, not implementer)
Skill: requesting-code-review
```

Verdict grammar `GO | REVISE | STOP`; findings `BLOCKER | MAJOR | MINOR` with file:line evidence. **One REVISE round maximum** (umbrella §0). Additionally probe the principle-test allowlists for any new artefact the stage introduces (`~/.claude/skills/orchestrator/SKILL.md` Phase -1 → «Principle-test allowlist probe»).

The reviewer surfaces strategy forks as «DECISION-NEEDED: <one-line>. Option A → consequence X. Option B → consequence Y.» and does NOT pick strategy, edit files, approve on the maintainer's behalf, or skip surface review because CI is green (T19).

**Re-run the four-arm in-flight probe immediately after Phase -1 completes, before the actual dispatch** — all three historical collisions materialised inside that window.

---

## §7a Reporting format

Any session message produced from this kickoff (Worker REPORT, reviewer verdict, mid-stage status, final handoff) ends with a `## 🟢 In plain words` block naming orchestration substance — sub-wave, acceptance item, `file:line`, REPORT-trace, dispatch state — not per-turn personal reasoning (that is the end-of-turn hook's job; duplicating it is `#two-prompts-drift`).

---

## §8 Stop conditions

- The Stage-1→2 `git ls-tree` gate returns fewer than two kickoff paths → halt; do not dispatch S-B or S-C.
- Any `gh` command errors while parallel stages are in flight → halt, escalate.
- A stage gate returns empty while that stage was expected merged → halt, report.
- Phase -1 returns STOP → halt, surface to maintainer.
- Any stage returns a BLOCKER finding → halt the stage; surface before proceeding.
- The in-flight probe hits an open PR / un-merged ahead-commits / a parallel session on the same stage → STOP and surface; one stage = one executor session.
- `fidelity-verdict-in-pr-body` is no longer a REQUIRED check at S-F dispatch time → dispatch S-F **without** the marker and surface; never edit a marker silently.
- Any temptation to edit `~/.claude/skills/orchestrator/` → violation; stop.

---

## §9 Anti-scope

- Do NOT write stage implementation code in this kickoff.
- Do NOT amend the umbrella kickoff or the design SSOT (Artifact Ownership Contract — the umbrella owns its own scope; disagreements go to the stage kickoff or a research-patch).
- Do NOT edit `session-start-token-audit/kickoff.md` — that umbrella owns it; the S-E dependency is declared here and re-verified at dispatch.
- Do NOT collapse S-B and S-C into one PR — one PR per stage.
- Do NOT open drive-by PRs for systemic issues noticed mid-stage; surface as an observation.
- Do NOT modify `~/.claude/skills/orchestrator/` (agent-uncommittable).
- Do NOT add npm deps.
